past.heading: A good time
past.text: This was a bright time, with something good happening often. A task you finished well earned you thanks. You spent on comfort and did not regret it. A small family function brought everyone together. Friends stayed close, and you enjoyed their company. A vehicle or home item was fixed or bought with ease. On the whole, you ended these months in a better place.

past.heading: A good time
past.text: These months felt easy and kind to you. Your seniors praised a task you handed in on time. Your salary came in full, and some extra came with it. A cousin's function at home was warm and cheerful. You and a colleague shared lunch and a good laugh most days. One busy week was tiring, but it ended well. Looking back, these months were smooth and pleasant.

future_free.heading: A mixed time
future_free.text: This is likely to be a mixed time, with ups and downs in about equal share. Your work may go on at an even pace, and a kind word from a senior is likely. Money in hand may stay about the same as before. A small family function may bring everyone together. A purchase for the home may be better kept for a little later. Friends may stay close, and an evening together may be a joy. Some weeks may be quiet and some full, so overall it may be an even mix.
